providers.name: Goldfish Swim School Gowanus
providers.shortDescription: Goldfish Swim School Gowanus offers swim lessons for all ages, from Mini (4-35 months) through Swim Force (5-12), plus indoor pool birthday parties and family swim.
providers.longDescription: Goldfish Swim School Gowanus offers structured swim lessons for swimmers of all skill levels: Mini (4-35 months), Junior (ages 3-4), Glider and Pro (ages 4-12), and the competitive Swim Force team (ages 5-12). Beyond lessons, the school hosts indoor pool birthday parties with games and activities, Family Swim sessions, and accelerated Jump Start Clinics.

providers.name: Gotham Gymnastics
providers.shortDescription: Gotham Gymnastics runs year-round classes across two Brooklyn locations for ages 18 months to 18 years, built on one consistent skill-progression philosophy at every level.
providers.longDescription: Gotham Gymnastics calls its approach the Gotham 360, and the same philosophy of safety, physical health and mental well-being applies whether a child is attempting their first cartwheel or training toward a Level 10 routine on bars. Classes run year-round rather than in short seasonal blocks, spanning an unusually wide age range from eighteen months all the way through eighteen years, which means the gym can be a single home for a child's entire gymnastics development rather than one stop among several as they progress. Enrollment itself is built for real commitment without being rigid about it: families sign up for the full year and their child's spot is held for the season, with a check-in at the halfway point rather than a hard lock-in. When school isn't in session, School's Out camps keep kids moving on the same equipment -- trampolines, a foam pit, and the bars -- across two Brooklyn locations.

announcement.title: Year-round, one philosophy at every level
announcement.description: The same Gotham 360 approach applies from a first cartwheel through Level 10 competitive training.

providers.name: GP81 Youth Training Center
providers.shortDescription: GP81 Youth Training Center is NYC’s first and only dedicated youth climbing facility. Open to the public with day rates for guests and free access for members.
providers.longDescription: The GP81 Youth Training Center, situated at 218 Randolph Street in Brooklyn, is an ideal destination for young climbers aged 8 and above. This facility offers a safe and supportive environment where participants can hone their climbing skills under professional guidance. Upon arrival, both parents and children must complete a participant agreement and attend a mandatory on-site safety orientation to ensure everyone's safety during activities. Parents can observe or participate alongside their kids, making it a fun and educational experience for the whole family.

providers.name: Grace's Gymnastics
providers.shortDescription: Grace's Gymnastics provides small group gymnastics classes for children of all ages in Brooklyn, NY. The program emphasizes building strength, coordination, and confidence.
providers.longDescription: Grace's Gymnastics is a boutique studio in Brooklyn, NY, offering small group gymnastics lessons for both girls and boys aged 3 and up. Located in Midwood and Sheepshead Bay, our program focuses on building essential skills like flexibility, balance, agility, coordination, endurance, and confidence through structured classes tailored to all skill levels. We provide a safe and supportive environment where students can master new skills such as forward rolls, handstands, cartwheels, back walkovers, back handsprings, and back tucks. Our USAG certified coaches ensure each child receives personalized attention, fostering a true sense of accomplishment. Parents can enroll their children in Recreational Gymnastics, Expo Team, or Mommy and Me classes, all designed to inspire young gymnasts to reach their full potential. Join us for a trial class today and see the difference we make in your child's life!

providers.name: Greenpoint YMCA — Traditional Summer Camp (2026)
providers.shortDescription: Greenpoint YMCA's summer camp runs swimming, arts and science programming for ages 3 to 12, with a sibling discount and registration for the next season opening each December.
providers.longDescription: Greenpoint YMCA's camp is built around the same four-part structure as the broader YMCA network's approach -- swimming, arts and crafts, science activities and theme days -- but pitched at a slightly younger range than some of its sibling branches, welcoming kids from age three through twelve. The program explicitly frames itself around social and emotional growth alongside the activities themselves, aiming to build community through team-building in a deliberately inclusive environment rather than treating inclusion as an afterthought. Families enrolling more than one child receive a sibling discount, and the camp requires at least one session's commitment rather than allowing single-day drop-ins. Registration for the next summer season opens each December.

providers.name: Gregor Gracie Jiu Jitsu
providers.shortDescription: Brooklyn Bridge Park-area Jiu-Jitsu academy, led by Master Gregor Gracie, offers a variety of classes for children and adults. Kids' classes are tailored to different age groups, while adults can participate in Jiu-Jitsu, No-Gi, and Muay Thai programs.
providers.longDescription: Gregor Gracie Jiu Jitsu offers classes for children at 153 Bridge Park Dr, Brooklyn, led by Master Gregor Gracie. The kids' program focuses on building confidence and discipline through engaging, age-appropriate classes that teach essential Jiu-Jitsu skills. Additionally, the academy provides an adult program for all experience levels, featuring No-Gi Jiu-Jitsu training that emphasizes control, submissions, and movement using body grips. A unique aspect of the Brooklyn location is its Muay Thai program, which specializes in striking techniques such as punches, kicks, knees, and elbows.

providers.name: Gymstars Brooklyn
providers.shortDescription: Gymstars Brooklyn provides gymnastics and dance classes for children aged 2 and older. The classes are designed to cater to different skill levels, with options for Tumble Tots, Skill Levels 1-3 in gymnastics, Rhythmic Gymnastics, and a variety of dance styles including Hip Hop and Ballet.
providers.longDescription: At Gymstars Brooklyn, children can participate in a range of physical activities that support their development. Gymnastics classes cater to both beginners and advanced participants, emphasizing skills such as balance, strength, and flexibility. Dance classes provide a fun and educational experience, featuring performances throughout the year. Both types of classes aim to enhance confidence and social skills.

providers.name: HAPIK
providers.shortDescription: Indoor rock climbing for all ages and skill levels, fostering confidence and fun.
providers.longDescription: HAPIK is an indoor rock climbing gym designed to be accessible and enjoyable for everyone. With no experience required, kids can set their own pace, push their limits, and discover what they can do through problem-solving and perseverance. The facility offers a variety of walls, from the 'first climb zone' with wide holds to more technical routes, ensuring there's something for every climber. Safety is prioritized with an automatic self-belay system that allows climbers to feel confident while climbing. Parents can watch their children grow in confidence as they climb together and share stories at dinner tables.

providers.name: Harlem Jets Sports & Youth Development
providers.address: 2280 Frederick Douglass Blvd, New York, NY 10027
providers.shortDescription: Harlem Jets has run free tackle football, cheer and wrestling programs for Harlem kids since 2005, built around a graduation-first philosophy its coaches state plainly.
providers.longDescription: Harlem Jets frames itself less as a football program that happens to help kids graduate and more as a graduation program that happens to run through football. "Failing school is not an option," one coach says of the approach; the organization states that more than 90% of kids who become Jets graduate high school, against a stated 63% baseline citywide for Harlem youth generally. Coaching staff describe the discipline of the field as inseparable from schoolwork, checking in on grades before practice rather than after a problem shows up. Alongside tackle football, cheer and a newer flag football program, the organization runs after-school social-emotional-learning meetups, tutoring and high school and college prep workshops, all free of charge -- extending its reach well past whichever sport a kid actually signed up for.

providers.name: Harlem School of the Arts
providers.address: 645 St. Nicholas Avenue, New York, NY 10030
providers.shortDescription: Harlem School of the Arts offers a comprehensive range of arts education for children from early childhood through young adulthood. The Dance program includes ballet, contemporary, jazz, tap, hip hop, and African dance. Additionally, the school provides a selective Prep Program for students aged 12-18, which offers full-scholarship pre-professional training.
providers.longDescription: Harlem School of the Arts provides instruction in five departments. HSA Dance includes ballet, contemporary, jazz, tap, hip hop, and African dance, with students participating in master workshops and performances. HSA Music focuses on musicianship, composition, and ensemble technique, emphasizing the jazz genre. Musical Theatre students learn the basics of voice, dance, and acting, while the Theatre program covers character work and stage and on-camera performance. The Media & Design program offers drawing, painting, illustration, digital media, animation, and cinematography. HSA Prep is a selective, tuition-free college-preparatory program for students aged 12-18, providing full scholarships, individual mentoring, and college application support, with auditions held each July-August.

providers.name: Harlem YMCA — Summer Day Camp
providers.shortDescription: Harlem YMCA runs a full-facility branch with a pool, gymnasium and group fitness classes for kids and teens in the heart of Harlem.
providers.longDescription: Harlem YMCA sits in what its own site calls the historic, diverse and culturally rich heart of Harlem, and the facility is built to match a full-service branch rather than a single-activity program: a pool, a basketball court and gymnasium, cardio and strength equipment, and family swim time alongside group fitness classes and lap swimming for kids and teens. That range means a family isn't choosing between swimming and general fitness -- both run under the same roof, on the same membership, at the same address on West 135th Street.

providers.name: Harlem Little League
providers.shortDescription: Harlem Little League runs community baseball camps for kids in Harlem, built around structured skill-building rather than just pickup games.
providers.longDescription: Harlem Little League treats itself as a community organization first and a baseball program second, framing its camps as much around giving young players a real opportunity as around the sport itself. Structured drills, games and scrimmages make up the core of each camp, with teamwork and sportsmanship built into the curriculum alongside the mechanics of hitting and fielding. A spring session runs each year, giving families a predictable window to plan around rather than scattered, one-off camp dates. For a Harlem family looking for something rooted in the neighborhood rather than a citywide franchise with a Harlem outpost, a community-based league carries a different kind of investment in the kids who show up season after season.

providers.name: Homage Skateboard Academy
providers.shortDescription: Homage Skateboard Academy in Brooklyn is relocating to a new location that offers double the space for skateboarding activities. The new facility includes a brand-new street course, transition area, lounge, and tech deck.
providers.longDescription: Homage Skateboard Academy offers skateboarding lessons and programs for kids of all ages. Located just 6 blocks away from Barclay Center and Atlantic Terminal, the academy features a new street course designed by Homage and Push Parks. With plenty of transition areas and a dedicated lounge, there's always something fun to do. This summer marks their 18th year of Summer Camp, providing an exciting environment for kids to learn and grow through skateboarding.

providers.name: Hoops Klub Fort Greene
providers.shortDescription: Hoops Klub Fort Greene is a basketball facility located at 28 Cumberland Street, near Fort Greene Park and the Navy Yard. They offer Hoops Klub Youth programs for children aged 4 to 18, as well as adult programs, events, and court rentals.
providers.longDescription: Hoops Klub -- Fort Greene is the flagship location of Hoops Klub, right by Fort Greene Park and the Navy Yard, a facility built for hoopers with pro-grade raw maple courts and flexible spaces that can be rented one at a time or taken over as a whole. The Full Court (90' x 50') includes a spectator bleacher area and is used for games, tournaments, large shoots and events. The Half Court (30' x 60') has spectator room for up to 20 with a dedicated bathroom, ideal for small-group games, training, private events and shooting practice. The Training Court (25' x 75') is built for clinics, youth sessions and private lessons, and there is also a Weight & Recovery Area with two squat racks, a dumbbell rack and two benches. Every Hoops Klub program runs here, including Hoops Klub Youth -- a Brooklyn hoops fam for ages 4 to 18, where skills, confidence and character get built, run by pros with Euro roots. Open Monday through Thursday 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM, Friday 7:00 AM to 12:00 AM, and Saturday through Sunday 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

providers.name: Hoops Klub Greenpoint
providers.shortDescription: Hoops Klub Greenpoint is a basketball facility located at 237 Russell Street in North Brooklyn. They offer youth programs for children aged 4 to 18, as well as adult programs, open runs, and court rentals.
providers.longDescription: Hoops Klub Greenpoint offers a variety of basketball programs for youth and adults, including training sessions, open runs, and open gym times. Located on Russell Street, the facility is conveniently accessible via the G train and McGuinness Boulevard. It features two courts: Court 1, a full-size hardwood court measuring 50' x 80', and Court 2, a slightly smaller court at 50' x 70'. Both courts are equipped with high-quality basketball hoops and premium hardwood floors, suitable for players of all skill levels. Programs cater to children aged 4 to 18 through the Hoops Klub Youth program, focusing on skill development, confidence building, and character education under the guidance of experienced professionals.

providers.name: Hudson River Community Sailing
providers.address: West 26th Street & 12th Avenue, Pier 66 Boathouse, New York, NY 10001
providers.shortDescription: Join us for a week-long summer sailing and STEM camp on the Hudson River, designed for kids aged 9 to 17. This exciting program takes place at a boathouse in Chelsea, offering eight sessions each July and August.
providers.longDescription:
City Sail is a week-long sailing and STEM camp organized by Hudson River Community Sailing, held at the Pier 66 Boat House. This camp is designed for kids aged 9 to 17, offering them a chance to escape the city and learn new skills while building their sailing knowledge. Participants are taught in small groups with a dedicated instructor, and no prior boating or swimming experience is necessary. Campers must be nine years old or older on the first day of their session. Teens aged 14 to 17 have the option to join the Teen Sailing Camp.

The camp runs for eight weeks each summer, and families can choose to sign up for one, two, or more weeks. Each week follows a general structure but includes varying lessons and activities. Participants can look forward to alternating weekly trips south toward the Statue of Liberty or north toward the Palisades and the George Washington Bridge. The program is committed to safety, ensuring it never cancels due to bad weather, and will switch to land-based activities and games if the water conditions are unsafe. Scholarships are available through the Hollis Salzman and David Barry Memorial Scholarship Fund for families with documented need.

providers.name: Imagine Swimming Crown Heights Armory
providers.shortDescription: Imagine Swimming's Crown Heights Armory location teaches swimming to babies, kids and teens starting at 18 months, in a safety-first instruction model.
providers.longDescription: Imagine Swimming's Crown Heights Armory pool serves families across Crown Heights and the surrounding Brooklyn neighborhoods, with lessons for babies, children and adults built around the same supportive, safety-first teaching model the organization runs at its other locations. The Armory location is open to swimmers starting at eighteen months old, with lessons offered every day of the week -- a level of availability that gives a family real flexibility around school and work schedules rather than a narrow weekly window.

providers.name: Imagine Swimming Upper West Side
providers.address: 752 West End Ave, New York, NY 10025
providers.shortDescription: Imagine Swimming's Upper West Side location offers a welcoming environment for children of all swimming abilities, from beginners to more experienced swimmers.
providers.longDescription: Imagine Swimming's Upper West Side facility is built to meet a child wherever they are with the water: a first-timer nervous about putting their face in, or a kid who already swims but wants to sharpen actual technique. Experienced instructors run every session with the dual goal of building genuine confidence and teaching real skill, not just keeping kids safely afloat for an hour. The facility is set up for flexible attendance rather than a rigid enrollment structure, which makes it easier for a busy family to fit swimming into a week that doesn't always look the same. For a parent on the Upper West Side who wants swim lessons without committing to a long, fixed schedule months in advance, that flexibility is worth as much as the instruction itself.

providers.name: Impact Youth League NYC
providers.shortDescription: Impact Youth League runs free Saturday basketball clinics and a paid winter league at a West Harlem school, part of a nonprofit that has worked with kids across the city for three decades.
providers.longDescription: Impact Youth League's West Harlem program is one branch of a nonprofit that started in Queens and has spent thirty years working with kids through basketball, now expanded into Manhattan, Brooklyn and New Jersey. The organization's stated mission goes beyond the sport itself: the goal is instilling discipline through basketball while pushing kids to make an impact in life by doing well in school, not just on the court. Two distinct entry points exist here. Free clinics run Saturday mornings at the West Harlem site, open to any kid who wants to work on fundamentals and more advanced drills without any cost barrier at all. The winter league is the other half -- a season-long, draft-based competitive league that registered players join for a one-time fee, with a lower-cost monthly payment plan and group discounts available for families who need them. A kid can walk in through the free clinics with nothing to lose, and only move into the paid league once they know they want the fuller commitment.

providers.name: Inwood Canoe Club
providers.address: Dyckman Street at the Hudson River, New York, NY 10034
providers.shortDescription: Join us for a free, volunteer-run Sunday kayaking open house on the Hudson River in Inwood. This event is open to paddlers aged 8 and up who know how to swim, and no prior experience is required.
providers.longDescription: Inwood Canoe Club hosts a free, public Open House every Sunday from Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day Weekend. Participants can enjoy guided 20-minute kayak trips on the Hudson River, just north of the George Washington Bridge. No prior paddling experience is necessary, but participants must know how to swim. All paddling equipment is provided. The minimum age is 8 years old, and minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. The club is located on Dyckman Street at the Hudson River, just south of the marina and The Hudson restaurant.

providers.name: Inwood Little League
providers.shortDescription: Inwood Little League, established in 1950, offers baseball and softball in upper Manhattan. This volunteer-run program caters to children aged 4 to 18.
providers.longDescription: Inwood Little League is New York City's longest-running Little League program, established in 1950. It operates continuously, ahead of many youth sports organizations in the city. Baseball and softball are offered to children aged four through eighteen, serving Inwood and its surrounding neighborhoods. The league is entirely volunteer-run and funded through registration fees, sponsorships, grants, and community fundraising. It does not have a paid administrative staff. The league's site is bilingual, switching between English and Español. Additionally, Inwood Little League runs a winter clinic outside the regular spring-summer-fall season, allowing families to remain involved during the colder months.

providers.name: JMA Brooklyn
providers.shortDescription: JMA Brooklyn provides martial arts classes for kids and adults focusing on Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and Kickboxing. Parents and children can work together to build skills like focus and confidence through these engaging classes.
providers.longDescription: JMA Brooklyn is a family-oriented facility dedicated to teaching martial arts such as Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and Kickboxing. The academy focuses on developing life skills like focus, confidence, and self-discipline in both children and adults. With experienced instructors who are part of the Caio Terra association, students can expect high-quality training that combines traditional methods with innovative techniques.

providers.name: Jodi's Gym
providers.shortDescription: Located on East 84th Street in New York, this gymnastics gym has been serving the community since 1982. They offer a variety of classes, including toddler, preschool, and competitive-track gymnastics. Additionally, they provide a Ninja Challenge program and camps for children.
providers.longDescription: Jodi's Gym, established in 1982, offers gymnastics classes for New York children from its location at 244 East 84th Street. Classes are organized by age and skill level, including a toddler gym for children aged 6 months to 3 years, preschool gymnastics for ages 3 to 5, and beginner-through-advanced gymnastics for ages 5 to 12. In addition to gymnastics, the gym provides a Ninja Challenge obstacle program, summer camps, school break camps, and gym-and-ninja birthday parties. Members have access to free open playtime outside of class hours and can opt for private lessons or join playgroups for families seeking personalized attention.

providers.name: Johnny Karate NYC
providers.shortDescription: Johnny Karate NYC provides martial arts classes for children, teens, and adults in Brooklyn. These classes are designed to help build discipline, confidence, and self-defense skills.
providers.longDescription: Johnny Karate NYC, situated at 164 Union St in Brooklyn, NY, is a prominent martial arts academy dedicated to transforming lives through traditional martial arts and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. The academy provides programs tailored for preschoolers, children, teens, and adults, emphasizing self-defense skills, discipline, respect, and personal growth. Parents and children alike can participate in a fun and enriching experience, learning valuable life skills while strengthening their bonds.

providers.name: JukeBox NYC Boxing & Training Facility
providers.shortDescription: Join JukeBox NYC for transformative kids' boxing classes. Enroll in a semi-private introductory session and enjoy complimentary gloves rental.
providers.longDescription: At JukeBox NYC Boxing & Training Facility, we offer kids boxing classes that focus on more than just self-defense. Our program helps build focus, confidence, respect, and discipline in children, skills that are important for both academic success and at home. We also provide a supportive community where kids can make friends and feel comfortable. Our semi-private intro class is a great way for your child to gain valuable life skills while having fun.

providers.name: Kano Martial Arts
providers.address: 149 West 27th Street, 1st Floor, New York, NY 10001
providers.shortDescription: This New York martial arts gym provides a dedicated Kids Judo class, along with adult Judo and Jiu Jitsu programs, all taught by internationally ranked instructors. They also offer a free trial class for newcomers.
providers.longDescription: Kano Martial Arts in New York offers a Kids Judo class that builds strength and confidence in a safe, supportive environment. The gym traces its Judo lineage back to Jigoro Kano, the sport's creator, and provides adult Judo and Jiu Jitsu programs. Instructors at the gym have international competition experience and teach Jiu Jitsu and No-Gi Grappling. New students, including families interested in the Kids Judo class, are encouraged to request more information and try a free first class. Class times are available in the mornings, afternoons, and evenings to accommodate different schedules. The gym welcomes people of all skill levels, from complete beginners to competitors preparing for tournaments.

providers.name: Karma Kids Yoga
providers.shortDescription: Karma Kids Yoga offers a fun and engaging yoga experience for children of all ages, focusing on building inner-strength and boosting self-esteem.
providers.longDescription: At Karma Kids yoga, children participate in engaging yoga classes designed to enhance their strength, flexibility, coordination, and overall physical and emotional well-being. These classes incorporate creative poses, games, mindfulness activities, music, and storytelling to help kids develop essential life skills. They learn valuable tools such as confidence, focus, body awareness, concentration, self-regulation, relaxation, kindness, empathy, compassion, collaboration, community, and self-love.

providers.name: Kew Kids Forest School
providers.shortDescription: Kew Kids Forest School leads small groups of children on nature walks and unstructured outdoor play in Central Park, meeting weekly with experienced guides who focus on building persistence, grit, and resilience.
providers.longDescription: Kew Kids Forest School gathers children in Central Park for an afternoon built around nature, not a classroom. Guides greet the group after school, hear about everyone's day, and then set off on a slow, curious walk through the park with plenty of room for play and conversation along the way. The program is deliberately unhurried, built on the idea that children develop persistence, grit, and resilience by discovering their own interests and working through challenges at their own pace, with guides who believe in their capacity to thrive. Sessions run across the fall, winter, and spring seasons and meet outdoors rain or shine, pausing only for extreme weather -- families are asked to dress for the elements and bring a snack and water. Because continuity matters to the group's sense of community, the program favors a small, consistent class over a drop-in structure, though new families can try a single trial session before committing. Optional day camps extend the program for families who want more.

providers.name: Kids at Work — Gentle Separation Preschool Prep
providers.address: 147 W. 24th St. Second Floor, New York, NY 10011
providers.shortDescription: Kids at Work's Gentle Separation class eases toddlers 18 months to 2.7 years away from a caregiver gradually, with the adult staying on site the whole time rather than a hard drop-off.
providers.longDescription: Kids at Work builds its Gentle Separation program around a genuinely gradual process, not a single hard goodbye: child and adult spend the first stretch of each class together in the room, doing messy art, sensory play and cooperative play, before the adult moves to a separate waiting area -- still on site the entire time, never truly gone. That structure matters specifically for the 18-month-to-2.7-year range this class serves, an age where a parent leaving the building entirely can undo weeks of trust-building in one bad morning. Multiple weekly schedules are available, including a lighter two-day option and a fuller four-day enrollment, and the program runs across the full year rather than a single fall-only term, with fall, winter-spring, full-year and summer options all available depending on when a family starts.

providers.shortDescription: Kids of Summer Sports NYC provides summer sports camps at Riverside Park fields in Manhattan. They offer baseball, basketball, flag football, and multi-sport options for children aged 4 to 16.
providers.longDescription: Kids of Summer Sports NYC offers single-week summer sports camps at Riverside Park Fields in Manhattan, with registration from June to August and a pre-season week ending September 4. The main camp, suitable for ages 4-13, includes Baseball, Basketball, Flag Football, Rookie Camp, and multi-sport activities from 8:45 am to 3:30 pm. Early drop-off, late pick-up, lunch, and transportation are available. For ages 13-16, the 60/90 Elite Baseball Summer Camp is available at Riverside Park Fields at West 107th Street. This camp focuses on intensive hitting, conditioning, fielding, pitching, and catching sessions on turf fields and two batting cages, aimed at players looking to enhance their skills or prepare for Fall ball.

providers.name: Kids Tennis Co
providers.shortDescription: Kids Tennis Co provides engaging, PLAY-based tennis lessons for children aged 2 to 7. Parents can register for ongoing classes and try a free trial session to determine if this is the right fit for their child.
providers.longDescription: At Kids Tennis Co, we focus on making tennis enjoyable and engaging for children of all ages. Our PLAY-based programs are tailored for kids aged 2-7, offering a fun and supportive environment where they can develop their skills while having a great time on the court. We provide ongoing registration, allowing parents to enroll their kids at any time, and offer free trial classes to help every child find the perfect class that suits their needs. Our program has been praised by parents like Ginger Zee from Good Morning America, who notes how her son Adrian has fallen in love with tennis thanks to our challenging yet entertaining drills.

providers.name: KidsUnited Park Slope
providers.shortDescription: KidsUnited Park Slope offers engaging indoor soccer programs for young children, focusing on skill development and fun.
providers.longDescription: KidsUnited Park Slope is a dedicated soccer program in Brooklyn's Park Slope neighborhood. They provide structured indoor soccer classes for kids aged 18 months to 9 years, fostering early childhood development through the game of soccer. The facility features a climate-controlled, padded-turf field, ensuring consistent play all year round. Classes are small and coached by certified professionals who offer personalized attention and feedback to each child. Parents can expect their children to develop confidence, teamwork, leadership, and resilience in a supportive community environment.

providers.name: Kings Bay Y
providers.shortDescription: Kings Bay Y offers a variety of classes for children and teens in Sheepshead Bay, including archery, swimming, tennis, basketball, and gymnastics.
providers.longDescription: At Kings Bay Y in Sheepshead Bay, we provide an array of enriching activities for kids and teenagers. Our programs include archery, where young participants can learn the skills to shoot a bow; swimming lessons that teach safety and technique in the water; tennis instruction that hones hand-eye coordination and strategy; basketball clinics that focus on teamwork and ball handling; and gymnastics classes that build strength and flexibility. These activities are designed to foster physical development, social interaction, and personal growth.

providers.name: Kokushi Budo
providers.shortDescription: Kokushi Budo provides judo classes for children in the Upper West Side of Manhattan. These classes aim to build confidence and discipline through structured training.
providers.longDescription: Kokushi Budo has been teaching judo to children since 1963. Their program is designed to build confidence, discipline, coordination, and respect in a safe environment. Classes are organized by age and ability level, ensuring that each student receives the right level of instruction. The youngest students focus on basic falling techniques and classroom discipline, while older students train with increased intensity and strategy.

providers.name: Kukdae Taekwondo
providers.shortDescription: Our Taekwondo studio offers a variety of programs tailored to different age groups. We have a dedicated Tiger Program for young children, a Youth Program for older kids, and a Teen and Adult Program for teenagers and adults.
providers.longDescription: Kukdae Taekwondo offers three distinct programs for different age groups: the Tiger Program for the youngest students, a Youth Program, and a Teen and Adult Program. The school emphasizes personalized instruction to help students achieve their goals, whether they aim for confidence and focus or fitness and strength. Instructors, described as professional masters, ensure that classes remain fun and safe. The studio fosters a community of focused, hard-working students who share similar objectives.

providers.name: Manhattan Plaza Racquet Club
providers.shortDescription: Manhattan Plaza Racquet Club is located next to Manhattan Plaza Health Club at 482 West 43rd St. They offer junior tennis programs on 5 indoor rooftop courts. The QuickStart program is designed for kids aged 4-10, while the Junior Programs cater to children aged 10 and above.
providers.longDescription: Manhattan Plaza Racquet Club is situated next to Manhattan Plaza Health Club at 482 West 43rd St. in Midtown Manhattan. It features 5 indoor championship tennis hard courts on a rooftop with a view of the Manhattan skyline, all under a new bubble with air conditioning. The club provides junior programs for children aged 10 and above, as well as a QuickStart Program tailored for kids aged 4 to 10. They also offer tennis clinics, tennis camps, tournaments, and round robins. A trial membership is available, distinct from the health club's membership.

providers.longDescription: Manhattan Youth operates the Downtown Basketball League, a longstanding community staple for over 30 years. This program offers a fun, safe, and educational basketball experience for children. It focuses on developing fundamental basketball skills, boosting self-confidence, and teaching teamwork and sportsmanship. The season kicks off in November with several months of skill-building and scrimmages, followed by formal team drafts in January. Weekday divisions are organized by grade and gender: 2nd/3rd Grade Boys play Friday evenings at PS234, 4th/5th Grade Boys compete on Thursday evenings at PS234 and PS89, 2nd/3rd Grade Girls play Tuesday evenings at PS234, 4th/5th Grade Girls play Wednesday evenings at PS234, and 6th/7th Grade Boys play Friday evenings at PS89. Saturday clinics are available throughout the day: 1st Grade Boys from 10:00 to 11:00am, 1st/3rd Grade Girls from 11:00 to 12:15pm, 2nd/3rd Grade Boys from 12:15 to 1:30pm, and 4th/5th Grade Boys and Girls from 1:30 to 2:45pm.

providers.name: Manny Cantor Center
providers.shortDescription: Manny Cantor Center is a community hub in the Lower East Side offering fitness, arts, early childhood education, and more for ages 0-100.
providers.longDescription: The Manny Cantor Center is a versatile community hub located in the Lower East Side, offering a wide range of activities. It provides art classes, basketball, group exercise classes, and small-group personal training, all under one roof. The center's welcoming message, "All are welcome!", highlights its inclusive approach, serving individuals of all ages from infancy through adulthood. This diversity makes it an ideal choice for families seeking a single membership that accommodates both a child's art class and a parent's fitness routine.

providers.shortDescription: The Marlene Meyerson JCC Manhattan is a community center at 334 Amsterdam Ave on the Upper West Side, with a pool, gym and studios running children's swimming, gymnastics, dance, art and music year-round.
providers.longDescription: The Marlene Meyerson JCC Manhattan occupies a purpose-built center at 334 Amsterdam Ave, at 76th Street. Its Children and Families program runs across the whole building: swimming lessons in the pool from infants upwards, gymnastics, youth tennis and soccer in the gym, and dance, ceramics, music and theater in the arts studios. There is a nursery school, after-school care and school-break programming, and Day Camp @ the JCC runs through the summer for children from age three, using the same pool and gym. Membership is not required for most classes, and the center also runs adult and older-adult fitness, film and cultural programming in the same building.

providers.name: Martial Arts Family Studio
providers.shortDescription: This Taekwondo studio provides age-graded martial arts classes for children from toddlers to teens. They also offer a ninja-style obstacle and tumbling class, as well as a competition team track.
providers.longDescription: Martial Arts Family Studio offers a variety of Taekwondo classes for children, starting with a Mommy & Me session for ages two to five. This class allows parents to join their children on the mat, providing a supportive environment for learning. As children grow, they progress through age-specific groups: Bleeker St Dragons, Houston St Monkeys, and Bowery St Tigers. Each group focuses on basic movements, blocking, forms, and belt promotions tailored to their skill level. For children six and older, a Ninja class is available, combining martial arts techniques with tumbling to enhance agility, balance, and coordination through obstacle-course challenges, flips, and rolls. Teenagers aged 13 to 18 can participate in a mixed class that combines Taekwondo, Karate, Kickboxing, and practical self-defense, fostering a sense of community during their teenage years. Those interested in competition can join the Competition Skills program, which offers options for sparring, forms, weapons, and an obstacle course track. Some classes are open to all members, while others are reserved for students who have reached a specific belt level. Additionally, the studio provides a separate program for babies and toddlers who are not yet ready for a full Taekwondo class.

Coach Eddie Martin leads Tae Kwon Do classes for youth and Kickboxing sessions for adults, focusing on both physical and mental development. Parents can enroll their children in Tae Kwon Do to help them develop discipline and self-confidence. Adults can participate in Kickboxing to enhance their fitness and self-defense skills.

providers.name: MatchPoint NYC Coney Island
providers.shortDescription: MatchPoint NYC's Coney Island club, located at 2781 Shell Road, is a family-friendly sports center featuring 8 tennis courts, a Junior Olympic Pool, and a Rhythmic Gymnastics Center. The club offers a variety of classes for children, ranging from Mommy & Me sessions to competitive team sports.
providers.longDescription:
MatchPoint NYC Clubs is a family-friendly fitness and sports center located at 2781 Shell Road in Coney Island. The facility includes an Oversized Fitness Center, an Outdoor Training Field, 3 Group Fitness Studios, a Junior Olympic Pool, 8 Tennis Courts, a Rhythmic Gymnastics Center, saunas, and a Gourmet Cafe. The Rhythmic Gymnastics program offers several options: Mommy & Me for 1-2-year-olds, a Pre-Team for ages 3 and up, a Competitive Team, Rhythmic Xcel, Private Lessons, a Summer Full-day Program, and Stretching, AcroGym, and Ballet.

Mommy & Me is a program where parents and children engage in play, socialization, and exercise together under the guidance of a qualified instructor. This program helps develop cognitive and social motor skills while promoting discipline and self-control. The Kids Fitness Program is designed to help children build strength, stay active, and have fun in a safe and welcoming environment. It focuses on healthy habits, strength, agility, coordination, confidence, and social skills.

Coach Viacheslav Osypov, with over 8 years of experience in working with children and teens in fitness and strength training, brings expertise from boxing, CrossFit, and weightlifting at a competitive level.

providers.name: McCarren Tennis Center
providers.shortDescription: McCarren Tennis Center offers tennis classes for all ages and skill levels, from beginners to high performance players. With 7 indoor hard courts open from 6am-12am, it's a top tennis club in Brooklyn.
providers.longDescription: At McCarren Tennis Center, you can find classes tailored for both adults and juniors. For adults, there are recreational clinics at various levels including Beginner, Advanced Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced. There’s also Cardio Tennis, which is a high-intensity workout designed to improve cardiovascular fitness through tennis drills and games. Juniors benefit from USTA junior development methods combined with Spanish footwork training and modern stroke techniques. The center caters to players aged 3-17, providing both recreational and high performance programs.

providers.name: Modern Martial Arts

providers.longDescription: Modern Martial Arts offers a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu school in Times Square, conveniently located near several major subway lines. Their Kids BJJ Program is designed for children aged 7 to 13, focusing on teaching the basics of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and mixed martial arts. The program is led by a team of staff who work with students of all ages and backgrounds, emphasizing the conditioning, strength, and flexibility benefits that Jiu-Jitsu training provides. New students, including kids, have the opportunity to try a free trial class. Additionally, the school provides a two-class introductory package that includes 1-on-1 instruction and a free trial uniform.

Kickboxing classes provide real martial arts techniques in small groups, ensuring individual attention from experienced teachers.

The Tribeca location also offers Brazilian Jiu Jitsu, full-service karate birthday parties, and an MMA Summer Camp. This camp combines martial arts games, creative crafts, and NYC field trips to enhance confidence, gross motor skills, and focus. New students have the opportunity to start a 2-class trial to experience the program before making a commitment.

The kids' martial arts program is highly rated as one of the best in downtown, with instructors who are black belts and dedicated to sharing their expertise.

Family Fun sessions allow members to explore the gym freely under supervision, and Kids Night Out offers a fun evening of games and gymnastics for parents to unwind.

As a nonprofit, the Academy accepts financial and in-kind donations to support the program, care for the horses, fund a student scholarship, and maintain facilities. providers.shortDescription: NYC Girls Soccer Club offers inclusive, girls-only soccer classes and leagues for children aged 2 to 13. These programs are held at various parks in Brooklyn, such as Carroll Park, JJ Byrne Park in Park Slope, and Brooklyn Bridge Park. Additionally, there is a free weekend program and a school-based afterschool pickup service.
providers.longDescription: NYC Girls Soccer Club offers an inclusive soccer program for girls aged 2-13 in Brooklyn. The afterschool program at Carroll Park is tailored for girls aged 5-9 from PS 29, PS 58, and the Brooklyn New School, with coaches providing pickup services. Practices on school days usually last about 1.5 hours. During Spring and Fall, a Sunday girls soccer league is held at J.J. Byrne Park in Park Slope for ages 5-8, from March 29th to June 21st, running from 9:30 am to 11:00 am. Additionally, the club provides free weekend soccer classes for ages 5-9 at Pier 5 in Brooklyn Bridge Park every Saturday during the Fall and Spring seasons, allowing players to develop skills and coaches to identify those interested in competitive soccer. For Girls Travel soccer, programs are available for players born between 2012 and 2017. For more information, contact them directly.

providers.name: Ocean Olympia Swimming School
providers.shortDescription: Ocean Olympia offers swimming classes for all ages, from beginners to advanced swimmers. Classes are designed to build comfort and confidence in the water while teaching essential swimming techniques.
providers.longDescription: Ocean Olympia Swimming School offers a supportive setting for both children and adults to learn swimming at their own speed. We tailor our classes to fit different skill levels, ensuring that beginners and experienced swimmers alike can find appropriate lessons. If you want to conquer your water phobia or enhance your swimming abilities, our instructors are committed to guiding you towards your aquatic objectives. Our primary focus is on fostering comfort and safety before diving into essential techniques such as proper kicking and breathing. With smaller class sizes, each student receives individualized attention, making the learning experience both effective and enjoyable.

providers.name: Oishi Judo Club
providers.shortDescription: Oishi Judo Club, established in 1969, offers judo classes for both children and adults on weekdays.
providers.longDescription: Oishi Judo Club, established in 1969 by Shiro Oishi, an 8th-degree black belt, is a longstanding judo institution in New York City. Children's classes are held on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday evenings, as well as on Saturday late morning, distinct from the adult classes. To join, children must be at least 5 years old. The club does not provide a free trial, but visitors are encouraged to observe a class before committing.

providers.name: OLAN Swim Team
providers.shortDescription: OLAN Swim Team offers affordable, intense swim training with passionate coaches in a fun and competitive environment.
providers.longDescription: OLAN Swim Team provides a comprehensive swimming program where children receive intensive training from experienced coaches. The team emphasizes more than just swimming laps; it includes competitions, cheering, record-breaking, and celebrating achievements. Potential members should have prior swimming experience and feel comfortable in the water. Tryouts are scheduled twice a month at Fort Hamilton High School Natatorium.

providers.name: Park Slope Day Camp
providers.shortDescription: Brooklyn Day Camp, established in 1992, offers eight weeks of summer activities. These include sports, swimming, arts, and trips. Activities take place across various sites in Park Slope, Carroll Gardens, and Windsor Terrace.
providers.longDescription: Park Slope Day Camp, established in 1992 and celebrating its 35th summer, aims to provide children with a fun-filled experience. It focuses on helping kids make friends, learn new skills, and stay active throughout the summer. The camp runs for eight weeks, typically from the end of June to late August. It offers a variety of programs, including traditional camp, sports, performing arts, and specialist tracks, tailored to the grade level of the children. The camp operates from sites in Park Slope, Carroll Gardens, and Windsor Terrace, with its office located at 694 5th Avenue. School-year programs are also available alongside the summer camp.

providers.name: Penguin City Swim Midtown East
providers.shortDescription: Penguin City Swim's Midtown East location provides swim lessons for children of all ages, from babies to adults, at 132 East 45th Street. They offer a variety of classes, including Water Babies, Small Group, Semi-Private, and Private lessons, all conducted in an 86-degree pool.
providers.longDescription: Penguin City Swim's Midtown East location offers a warm and inviting environment for swimmers of all ages, with its consistently maintained 86-degree pool water. The facility is open seven days a week, providing flexibility for families to fit swimming into their schedules. Water Babies classes are a highlight, designed for children aged six months to two years and a half, where they can learn essential water safety skills through fun activities like singing and games. For older swimmers, Small Group lessons cater to those who can swim short distances independently, with a 1:4 student-to-teacher ratio ensuring personalized attention. Semi-Private lessons are perfect for beginners aged two and up, focusing on basic swimming techniques in a smaller class setting of one instructor per two students. Private lessons offer one-on-one instruction, ideal for swimmers looking to refine their stroke technique or overcome fears of the water. Adult classes are also available, accommodating both beginners and those seeking advanced training. The pool's 18.5-yard length offers ample space for all skill levels to improve their swimming abilities.

providers.name: Pier 2 Roller Rink
providers.shortDescription: Located at Brooklyn Bridge Park's Pier 2, the outdoor roller rink offers regular children's skate lessons, birthday parties, and school field trip packages.
providers.longDescription: Pier 2 Roller Rink at Brooklyn Bridge Park offers Children Skate Lessons, open skate sessions, and adult skate classes. It is renowned as the top destination in Brooklyn for children's birthday parties, field trips, and fundraisers for schools and groups. The rink provides packages tailored for schools and groups of various sizes. Additionally, it hosts recurring free-admission sessions and seasonal events throughout the year.

providers.name: PLAY Kids Greenpoint
providers.shortDescription: PLAY Kids Greenpoint offers soccer lessons taught by a former professional, emphasizing balance, coordination, and teamwork. Classes are available at McCarren Park or Play Greenpoint.
providers.longDescription: PLAY Kids Greenpoint offers a 10-week soccer program for children aged 18 months to 6 years. This program emphasizes developing essential skills like balance, coordination, core strength, and teamwork through engaging games and small class sizes. Experienced coaches lead the classes, making them suitable for both beginners and those looking to improve their abilities. Parents can drop off their children at McCarren Park or Play Greenpoint on Saturdays and Sundays.

providers.name: PlayWell Brooklyn Open-Play
providers.shortDescription: Inclusive indoor play space for all ages offering open-play, classes, and birthday parties.
providers.longDescription: PlayWell Brooklyn is an inclusive play space designed for both neurodivergent and neurotypical kids, offering a fun environment to develop social skills and fitness through open-play sessions, movement or arts & crafts classes, and birthday parties. Parents can enjoy drop-in visits or become members with various plans that include unlimited access to the venue, special events, and discounts on classes and parties. The space features modular play areas fostering creativity, curiosity, and confidence in children of all abilities.

announcement.title: Open-play runs every week

providers.name: Premier Martial Arts
providers.shortDescription: Premier Martial Arts offers comprehensive martial arts programs for kids and adults, focusing on building confidence, self-defense skills, and physical fitness.
providers.longDescription: Premier Martial Arts in Brooklyn Heights offers a dynamic environment where both kids and adults can enhance their physical fitness, mental resilience, and personal growth through martial arts training. Our programs are tailored to meet the needs of individuals ranging from 3-year-olds to adult enthusiasts looking to improve self-defense skills and overall well-being. Parents and children can participate together in classes designed to foster discipline, confidence, and leadership. Whether it's a child developing essential life skills or an adult seeking a fulfilling fitness routine, Premier Martial Arts provides a supportive community where everyone can thrive.

providers.name: Prospect Park YMCA
providers.shortDescription: The YMCA branch on 9th Street in Park Slope offers a variety of activities for children, including swim lessons, tennis, basketball, soccer, and a summer day camp.
providers.longDescription: The Prospect Park YMCA, located at 357 9th Street, is the primary swimming facility for Park Slope and Gowanus. It offers learn-to-swim programs in various stages, starting from water acclimation for the youngest children and progressing to more advanced skills. In addition to swimming, the YMCA provides youth tennis, beginner and intermediate basketball, soccer, and a summer day camp. As a YMCA, the pricing is tailored to the neighborhood, and financial assistance is available to help families afford the programs.

providers.name: Prospect Park Youth Running Club
providers.shortDescription: Prospect Park Youth Running Club is a volunteer-led organization that trains nearly 150 young runners aged six to eighteen. They focus on track and field and cross country.
providers.longDescription: Prospect Park Youth Running Club is a Brooklyn-based youth Track & Field and Cross Country team that nurtures athletes from age six through eighteen. The club focuses on proper training methods, injury prevention, rest and recovery, and mental preparation to help athletes succeed in competition while fostering a sense of community within its dynamic family. With over 150 athletes and more than a dozen coaches, the club is a non-profit organization affiliated with USATF and AAU.

providers.name: Range Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
providers.shortDescription: Upper East Side Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu offers a Little Warriors program for children aged 5-9 and a Teen Warriors program for ages 10-13, along with adult classes.
providers.longDescription: Range Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu is located in the Upper East Side, on East 61st Street. The Little Warriors Jiu-Jitsu program is designed for children aged 5 to 9 and focuses on teaching respect, discipline, patience, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. This program is engaging and aims to build self-assurance. For ages 10 to 13, the Teen Warriors program provides a more focused introduction to Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, helping students develop stronger coordination and a sense of personal identity. Adult classes offer both Gi and No-Gi Jiu-Jitsu, starting with beginner programs that cover the fundamental movements, positions, and control necessary for the art.

providers.name: Renzo Gracie Academy
providers.shortDescription: Renzo Gracie Academy is a renowned martial arts school in Midtown Manhattan, offering Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Muay Thai, and MMA classes for all ages. The focus is on building confidence through self-defense techniques.
providers.longDescription: Renzo Gracie Academy is one of the world's leading schools in martial arts, established in 1996. Located at 224 West 30th Street in Midtown Manhattan, it provides Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Muay Thai, and MMA classes for individuals of all ages and experience levels. The academy emphasizes building confidence through self-defense techniques rather than just teaching martial arts. Classes are taught by experienced instructors with decades of expertise.

providers.name: RiseBoro Youth Center
providers.shortDescription: The RiseBoro Youth Center offers a variety of drop-in activities for youth, including basketball, fitness classes, photography, and dance. Located in Brooklyn, it's open 6 days a week.
providers.longDescription: RiseBoro Youth Center provides a range of recreational programs for young people in Brooklyn. The center features a full-sized gymnasium with a regulation basketball court, a fitness room, a technology room, an auditorium, and multiple classrooms. On evenings and weekends, the center hosts activities such as basketball, volleyball, and fitness classes, photography instruction where students learn black and white film techniques, and dance lessons. These programs are funded by the NYC Department of Youth and Community Development.

providers.name: Ronin Athletics
providers.address: 265 Madison Ave, 5th Floor, New York, NY 10016
providers.shortDescription: A Manhattan gym near Grand Central provides Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and kickboxing classes for both children and adults.
providers.longDescription: Ronin Athletics has trained students in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in New York City since 2001 and is the official Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Certified Training Center for all of Manhattan. The gym is located at 265 Madison Ave, on the 5th floor, three blocks south of Grand Central Station and two blocks southwest of the New York Public Library and Bryant Park, with its entrance on the north east corner of 39th Street. Founder and head coach Christian Montes is a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt with professional kickboxing experience, and the gym's programs are built for adults and kids together. The Jiu-Jitsu curriculum follows Grandmaster Helio Gracie's self-defense-first approach rather than a purely sport or competition focus, teaching technique built around timing and positioning that the gym's own materials describe as useful for situations such as a child being bullied by another child. Ronin Athletics also runs a Kickboxing program, developed by the gym's founder, that blends Western Boxing, Muay Thai and Dutch-style Kickboxing without training students toward fight competition. A member visiting from another Gracie Certified Training Center can train at the Manhattan location for up to 30 consecutive days a year at no charge, arranged in advance by email.

providers.name: Row New York
providers.address: 3579 Harlem River Drive, New York, NY 10034
providers.shortDescription: Join Row New York's high school rowing team with no experience required. Develop potential in the boat, classroom, and life through rigorous academic support.
providers.longDescription: Row New York transforms lives through the discipline of rowing and rigorous academic support. Our year-round programs offer opportunities for youth, adult, and adaptive athletes to thrive. Join our high school team without needing prior experience. Discover your potential on and off the water while receiving comprehensive academic assistance. Celebrate success stories from our crews and be part of one of the most inspirational nights in rowing.

providers.name: SamboCenter
providers.shortDescription: SamboCenter offers Judo classes for all ages, from 5 to 65 years old. The club has an active roster of 150 students and is known for its strong training programs that help build confidence, discipline, and self-defense skills.
providers.longDescription: Founded in 1996, SamboCenter is a Judo club based in Brooklyn and also has a location in Staten Island. The club offers more than just physical training; it emphasizes Judo as a lifestyle that builds strength, confidence, and unity. Students of all ages—from kids and teens to adults—can participate in classes tailored to their age groups. Parents can expect their children to gain independence, improve their health, learn self-defense skills, and develop respect for others through regular practice.

providers.name: Seido Karate
providers.shortDescription: Seido Karate offers a blend of traditional Japanese karate and modern fitness techniques, suitable for kids, teens, and adults. Classes focus on building confidence, strength, and discipline in a supportive environment.
providers.longDescription: Seido Karate is dedicated to the practice of traditional Japanese karate with a modern approach to fitness, community, and personal growth. The program caters to beginners and experienced martial artists alike, offering tailored classes for kids aged 4-12, teens aged 13-17, and adults over 18. Each age group benefits from fun activities and special events that foster focus, discipline, and confidence. Additionally, Seido offers meditation classes and self-defense training to enhance the overall martial arts experience.

providers.name: SFX Youth Sports
providers.shortDescription: SFX Youth Sports is a volunteer-run Brooklyn program with a century of combined history, offering soccer, basketball and flag football for kids ages 4 to 17.
providers.longDescription: SFX Youth Sports runs entirely on parent volunteers -- the coaches, the people organizing seasons, the ones actually running practice, are the same parents whose kids play in the program. That volunteer structure is paired with genuinely deep roots in the Brooklyn community: the organization describes over a century of combined experience behind its programs, spanning soccer, basketball and flag football for kids from age four through seventeen. A full fall calendar runs multiple sports simultaneously -- baseball and softball, flag football, soccer and a basketball skills clinic -- so families aren't limited to one sport per season if a kid wants to try more than one. Winter brings a basketball league that opens registration well ahead of its actual start, giving families time to plan around it. What the organization emphasizes throughout is less about producing elite athletes and more about teamwork, sportsmanship and respect -- values a volunteer-run program built by the same parents who show up to coach tends to take seriously.

providers.name: Sheridan Fencing Academy - Manhattan
providers.shortDescription: An Upper East Side fencing club offers sabre classes for children as young as four. They provide a free trial class before enrolling in a full session.
providers.longDescription: Sheridan Fencing Academy's Manhattan location is situated at 1801 1st Avenue on the Upper East Side. This facility features six full-length fencing strips, two-story ceilings, and change rooms, and provides all necessary equipment, including modified gear for younger children. Fencing lessons for kids begin at age four in 40-minute group sessions that focus on motor skills and basic movement, taught in the sabre discipline. For ages seven to nine, there is a youth program that lasts for an hour, building on these fundamentals with games and coordination exercises. Teens aged ten and older can join a program that offers longer, more advanced sessions with periodic skill tests. The Manhattan location is open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday. New students have the opportunity to try a class before committing, as the academy offers free trial fencing classes for those interested in the sport.

providers.name: Shinkai Dojo
providers.shortDescription: Shinkai Dojo offers traditional Shotokan Karate for children and families in Lower Manhattan. Classes focus on skill development, confidence building, and discipline.
providers.longDescription: At Shinkai Dojo, kids and families can learn authentic Shotokan Karate in a supportive environment. The dojo emphasizes purposeful instruction and genuine progress over quick rewards. Students of all ages can join classes designed to build technical skills, confidence, and character through structured training. Early Childhood Karate (ages 3-5) introduces young students to karate with fun, structured classes that enhance coordination, listening skills, and respect. Youth Karate (ages 6-11) focuses on building focus, discipline, and fundamental techniques. Family Karate (ages 6+) allows children, teens, and adults to train together in a traditional setting. Each class has a clear purpose, ensuring meaningful progress for every student.

providers.name: Shorefront Y SwimRight Academy
providers.shortDescription: Shorefront Y's SwimRight Academy provides Private, Parent Tot, Group, and Stroke Advance swim lessons for children aged 3 months to 16 years. Lessons begin with a free evaluation class.
providers.longDescription: Shorefront Y's SwimRight Academy caters to swimmers aged from newborns to 16 years old. Every new participant begins with a complimentary evaluation session, which is a brief private lesson lasting about 10 to 15 minutes to assess the appropriate level and type of lessons needed. The academy offers various classes including Private Lessons (available in 15 or 30-minute sessions for swimmers aged 1.5 years and older), Parent Tot Classes (lasting 30 minutes, suitable for children from 3 to 24 months), Group Lessons (25 minutes long, designed for ages 4 to 16), and Stroke Advance Lessons (offered in 30-minute sessions for swimmers aged 4 to 16). Monthly billing applies. Additionally, a 7% sibling discount is provided, and first-time enrollees receive a swim cap and progress book as part of their registration. Classes are available from 2:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

providers.name: SKATEYOGI Prospect Lefferts Gardens
providers.shortDescription: Indoor skateboarding school in Prospect Lefferts Gardens offers weekly classes for children aged 3 to 15, along with day camps and private lessons. Established 13 years ago, the school has been featured in The New York Times.
providers.longDescription: SKATEYOGI has taught skateboarding out of its Prospect Lefferts Gardens space since being founded 13 years ago with two Brooklyn locations. Weekly classes run from Juniors (ages 3-6) through a combined Kids and Teens series (ages 5-15), covering stance, pushing, turning, stopping, and skatepark etiquette in an open-level, no-rules format the school describes as an ego-free zone. Beyond weekly classes, SKATEYOGI runs school-holiday day camps for kids 5 to 14 and offers private lessons on-site. The New York Times highlighted the school for its flexible week-by-week summer camps and after-school programming.

providers.shortDescription: The Skating School at LeFrak Center at Lakeside, located at 171 East Drive in Brooklyn, offers classes for children aged four and up. These classes follow the Learn to Skate USA curriculum and are available in various levels, from Parent and Me to advanced levels.
providers.longDescription: Skating School at Lakeside offers a comprehensive ice-skating program that caters to skaters of all ages and skill levels, from children aged four and up to adults. The program follows the Learn to Skate USA curriculum and provides classes on both a Covered Rink and an Oval Rink. Each class includes rental skates and free practice time on a public session the same day, allowing participants to apply what they've learned in a real skating environment. Levels include Parent and Me for ages 2-3, Snowplow Sam 1 to 3-4 for ages 4-6, Basic 1-2, and Basic 3-4 for ages 7-14. The program is designed to be inclusive and supportive, making it a great place for beginners to learn the basics or for more experienced skaters to refine their skills. For more information, contact the Skating Department at 718-340-3312, ext. 6002.

providers.name: Sky Rink Ice Skating & Ice Hockey
providers.shortDescription: Join Sky Rink for year-round ice skating and hockey classes, camps, and public sessions. Perfect for all ages to learn, stay active, and connect through the ice.
providers.longDescription: Sky Rink at Chelsea Piers provides a range of activities for skaters and hockey players of all ages. Learn to Skate classes begin as early as age 3, helping young skaters develop balance, confidence, and skills in a fun setting. For older children and adults, there are Youth Hockey Classes that follow USA Hockey guidelines, Cyclones Travel Hockey programs for players aged 8-18, and Adult Hockey Leagues that focus on teamwork and competition. Public skating sessions are available for those who want to skate with friends or practice. Summer camps are open to ages 3 and up, offering a fun-filled summer of ice skating and hockey. Birthday parties are also an option, featuring ice time, rentals, and dedicated party space. Locker rentals and ice rental services are available to make the most of the rink's amenities.

providers.name: SNACK NYC
providers.shortDescription: SNACK* is a nonprofit organization that provides small-group classes and activities for children, teens, and young adults of all abilities. They offer a variety of programs, including Snacktivities and private swim lessons, allowing participants to progress at their own pace.
providers.longDescription: SNACK* is a 501c3 not-for-profit organization that started as an after-school program for six children and has expanded to offer a variety of classes and activities for children, teens, and young adults. Founded by a family with two sons, one with severe autism and the other typically developing, the organization aims to create a welcoming environment for both. Snacktivities are hour-long classes led by instructors trained in their respective fields, with small class sizes to ensure a high staff-to-participant ratio. This setup allows for personalized attention to meet the needs of all abilities. Additional offerings include one-on-one private Swim lessons focused on safety, strokes, floating, and breathing, Snack 21+ programming for older participants, and an in-house print shop that functions as a technology classroom teaching graphic design and ecommerce skills.

We offer weekly classes from Parent & Me to fundamentals and development programs, accessible 7 days a week. Drop in anytime without waiting for a new season! For older kids, we provide half-day and full-day camps during school breaks and summer, ideal for skill development and making friends.

providers.name: South Brooklyn Fencing Club
providers.shortDescription: South Brooklyn Fencing Club teaches youth fencing classes year-round in Brooklyn, starting with a private introductory lesson package for beginners as young as 6 and continuing into ongoing Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced group classes.
providers.longDescription:
Experience the thrill of fencing at South Brooklyn Fencing Club, located in the heart of Brooklyn. Our club caters to both beginners and advanced athletes, offering a dynamic and inclusive environment for all ages. Young students as young as six can start with our private Introductory Program, which includes three 20-minute sessions that introduce the basics of fencing. From there, participants move through Youth, Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced group classes held multiple days a week. We also offer day and summer camps for those seeking longer-term training.

Led by FIE-certified international referee Anibal Alvear, our coaching team provides personalized attention and guidance to every student. With a strong track record of success, including participation in national and international events such as the Junior Pan American Games and World Championships, South Brooklyn Fencing Club is dedicated to fostering a community of skilled fencers.

Sessions run twice each morning back to back, so there is room to fit a visit into a range of morning schedules. The classes are included for members and there is no need to book ahead; the invitation is literally to just come on down. Activities rotate through arts and crafts, singalongs, dance parties, and even the occasional storytelling or craft session built around a theme, which keeps the week varied rather than repeating the same activity for toddlers who might get there most mornings.

It was established in 2019 and has since expanded to include over 260,000 square feet of facilities. The club features 29 hard and soft-surface tennis courts, three dedicated padel courts, an athletic training center, a cafe, a pro shop, and lounge spaces. During the summer, five hard-surface and seven soft-surface courts are available outdoors, while the remaining seventeen courts remain enclosed year-round. SPORTIME is open 365 days a year, from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM daily. It offers group and private tennis and padel instruction, athletic training, and summer and school-break camps for juniors and adults of all ages and skill levels. Non-members can participate in camps, some introductory programs, and non-discounted court rentals. Members have full access to programs, including JMTA training, discounted court time, and reciprocal privileges at other SPORTIME clubs.

providers.shortDescription: Harlem nonprofit offers squash instruction, academic tutoring, college access support, community service, and mentoring for young people aged 11 to 24. They train at their own SL Green StreetSquash Center.
providers.longDescription: StreetSquash, established in 1999, is a youth development nonprofit based in Harlem. It combines on-court squash instruction with academic support, community service, college and career preparation, leadership training, and mentoring for individuals aged 11 to 24. Training occurs at the SL Green StreetSquash Center, where coaches who have competed at high levels initiate all participants in a recreational program; many advance to a performance track during their high school years, competing in Bronze, Silver, and Gold tournaments. Through its membership in the Squash and Education Alliance (SEA), StreetSquash also competes against other urban squash programs. Many graduates go on to play for college teams through the College Squash Association. The organization reports that 100% of participants graduate high school, with 97% moving on to college or another post-secondary program, and 68% completing their college education — figures significantly higher than the national average for students in similar demographics.

This initiative reaches over 900 young people annually, with participants from more than twenty nationalities, showcasing the diverse backgrounds of the neighborhoods. Many families find that a paid club is unaffordable, and the academy provides a welcoming environment for them. In addition to the open sessions, the academy offers age-specific tracks: Chiquiticos for children aged four to six, and the Heights Soccer League for those aged seven to nineteen, seeking structured and competitive play. Families and participants alike appreciate the program's focus on building confidence alongside skill development, as kids feel safe, supported, and motivated.

providers.name: Vanderbilt Tennis Club
providers.shortDescription: Vanderbilt Tennis Club is located on the 4th floor of Grand Central Terminal and has been open to the public since 1993. They offer Junior Programs on indoor courts for children aged 3 through 12 and older.
providers.longDescription: Vanderbilt Tennis Club is situated on the 4th floor of Grand Central Terminal and has been open to the public since 1993. The club offers Junior Programs that align with the United States Tennis Association Junior Pathway. These programs are designed for different age groups, each with its own equipment: the Three's Program for children aged 3, Red Ball 1 for ages 4-5, and Red Ball 2 for ages 6-7. Orange Ball is available for children aged 8-9, Green Ball for ages 10-11, and Yellow Ball for ages 12 and above. All activities take place on championship-quality indoor tennis courts, located in a basement or school gym, rather than outdoors. The student-to-instructor ratio is generally 4:1.

providers.name: Vanderbilt YMCA
providers.shortDescription: The Vanderbilt YMCA provides a range of fitness classes and swimming activities suitable for all ages. Situated near Grand Central Terminal, it's an ideal location for individuals seeking to resume their fitness routines.
providers.longDescription:
The Vanderbilt YMCA is located in Midtown East, near Grand Central Terminal and Times Square, and offers a variety of facilities for both parents and children. It includes modern exercise equipment such as cardio and strength training machines, basketball courts, and running tracks. There are also two pools available for swimming and water activities. Family programs are designed to help members reach their fitness goals.

For parents, the YMCA offers a supportive community where they can participate in various activities with their children. Kids can enjoy supervised playtime, sports, and other fun programs that promote physical health and social skills. The facility is equipped with everything needed for a fulfilling workout or an enjoyable family day out.

providers.name: Victory Gymnastics Brooklyn
providers.shortDescription: Victory Gymnastics in Brooklyn offers a variety of gymnastics and tumbling classes for kids from 2 years old through teenagers. Classes are designed to be fun, safe, and supportive.
providers.longDescription: Victory Gymnastics School in Brooklyn offers a warm and inspiring space for kids to explore gymnastics and tumbling. Whether your child is just starting out or has been practicing for some time, we have classes tailored to their skill level. Our experienced coaches focus on building strength, confidence, and flexibility through fun and engaging activities. With modern facilities designed specifically for gymnasts, Victory Gymnastics provides a supportive environment where every child can thrive. Come join us and see the difference in your child's growth and enjoyment of gymnastics.

providers.name: Village Community Boathouse
providers.address: Pier 40, 353 West St, New York, NY 10014
providers.shortDescription: Village Community Boathouse provides free, no-experience-required community rowing on the Hudson River at Pier 40. Additionally, they offer a Youth Rowing program specifically for high school students every Friday afternoon.
providers.longDescription: Village Community Boathouse offers free, no-experience-required Community Rowing on the south side of Pier 40 on the Hudson River. Participants are paired with an experienced coxswain in a Whitehall gig, a traditional four-oared rowboat. Each session includes a brief orientation, and life jackets are provided. Students can participate in free rowing and later join the race team for various events across the Northeast.
