providers.name: VITAL Climbing Gym - West Harlem
providers.shortDescription: VITAL Climbing Gym in West Harlem provides bouldering and yoga classes for all ages. You can visit to try these activities or buy a membership for unlimited access.
providers.longDescription: VITAL Climbing Gym - West Harlem is situated at 3225 Broadway and provides a lively environment for climbers of all skill levels. The gym features bouldering areas and yoga classes, making it ideal for both skill enhancement and exploring new activities. Parents and children can enjoy the facility together. Children can practice their climbing skills while parents can join in or use the time to participate in a yoga class. With 24/7 access available through membership options, you can visit anytime for a single session or purchase a punch pass for multiple visits.

providers.name: Warriors Nation MMA
providers.shortDescription: Warriors Nation MMA in Dumbo, Brooklyn, provides a well-organized kids' martial arts program designed to enhance confidence, focus, and practical self-defense skills. This program is suitable for children of all skill levels and covers a range of topics, including Jiu Jitsu, MMA fundamentals, and fitness.
providers.longDescription: Our Kids Program in Brooklyn is a structured training program designed to build discipline, confidence, and real self-defense skills for children aged 3-14. Led by experienced coaches at our Dumbo location, kids learn Jiu Jitsu, MMA fundamentals, Boxing, Wrestling, and Muay Thai in a safe, supportive environment. This program helps children develop focus, respect, teamwork, and leadership while staying active and having fun. Perfect for all skill levels, it creates a strong foundation for both martial arts and everyday life. Parents can expect their child to gain confidence, coordination, and a sense of community through personalized coaching and positive reinforcement. Families across Brooklyn appreciate the focus on character-building, helping students develop resilience and discipline both on and off the mats. Your child’s journey begins with a welcoming introduction and ongoing classes that emphasize skill development, teamwork, and structured routines.

trial.text: Discover the power of authentic Muay Thai in DUMBO, Brooklyn, with beginner-friendly striking classes covering punches, kicks, elbows, knees, and clinch work, plus your first class absolutely free.

providers.name: Wendy Hilliard Gymnastics Foundation
providers.shortDescription: Wendy Hilliard Gymnastics Foundation provides gymnastics classes for children aged 3 to 17 at the Harlem Children's Armory. The classes include an introductory Community Gymnastics Program and an invitation-only Intermediate class for pre-team athletes.
providers.longDescription: Wendy Hilliard Gymnastics Foundation offers Harlem gymnastics classes at the Harlem Children's Armory, located at 40 W 143rd St. The Community Gymnastics Program is designed for beginners and focuses on teaching essential gymnastics skills, including handstands, backbends, cartwheels, rhythmic gymnastics, and tumbling. It also includes choreography-based warm-up routines. The Intermediate class is invitation-only and serves as a stepping stone to the foundation's pre-team and team programs. This class meets once a week for 1.5 hours, with coaching tailored to each gymnast's strongest discipline.

providers.name: West Side YMCA — Traditional Summer Camp (2026)
providers.shortDescription: West Side YMCA runs three age-banded summer camp tiers -- Early Childhood, Kinder and Traditional -- for kids 3 to 12, with registration for the next season opening each December.
providers.longDescription: West Side YMCA splits its summer camp by developmental stage rather than running one program stretched across every age: Early Childhood Camps for three- and four-year-olds, Kinder Camps specifically for kids entering kindergarten, and Traditional Summer Camps for ages six through twelve, mixing standard camp activities like swimming, creative arts and science experiments with theme days built in throughout the summer. Every tier runs under the same stated values -- respect, caring, honesty and responsibility -- and families enrolling more than one child receive a sibling discount. Registration for the next summer season opens each December.

providers.name: Williamsburg Baseball Academy
providers.shortDescription: Williamsburg Baseball Academy offers elite baseball training for young athletes aged 1st to 5th grade, focusing on skill development, character building, and confidence. Led by experienced coaches like Tony Hubbard and Frank Alameda.
providers.longDescription: Williamsburg Baseball Academy provides top-tier baseball training for children in the Williamsburg neighborhood of Brooklyn. Founded by Tony Hubbard, a graduate of UNC Chapel Hill, the academy aims to bring ACC and SEC-style training programs to the area. Coaches like Frank Alameda and Joe Caracci offer structured after-school sessions and summer camps that emphasize clean mechanics, situational awareness, and leadership development.

providers.name: Williamsburg Soccer Club
providers.shortDescription: Youth soccer club in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, provides weekly coed classes for players aged 18 months to 10 years. They also offer a drop-in option, a recreational league, and after-school clinics.
providers.longDescription: Williamsburg Soccer Club runs coed youth soccer classes in Williamsburg, Brooklyn for players ages 18 months to 10 years old. Weekly classes run throughout the year and are automatically prorated for families who join mid-season. Commitment is full term or drop ins available for families who cannot commit to a weekly schedule. Fall sessions (September through December) run Saturday through Thursday at the WSC Clubhouse, The Post, McCarren Park, William Sheridan Playground and Newtown Barge Playground; summer sessions (July and August) run on Saturday at the WSC Clubhouse, 33 Nassau Ave. Beyond the weekly classes, the club runs a recreational league with a weekly practice session and weekend games for players ready for a more competitive option, and After School Soccer Clinics for players ages 5-7, held Monday through Thursday after school until 5pm with pickup available from PS31, PS34 and PS110 or parent/guardian drop off.

providers.name: Wollman Rink
providers.shortDescription: Wollman Rink offers a private ice skating program where skaters receive personalized lessons from figure skating, ice dance, and hockey coaches. This program is designed for skaters of all levels, providing them with the opportunity to improve their skills in a supportive and structured environment.
providers.longDescription: Wollman Rink provides private ice skating lessons tailored to various skill levels, with coaches who have extensive experience in figure skating, ice dance, and hockey. Elizabeth, a double USFS Gold Medalist and Disney on Ice tour participant, offers Learn to Skate programs and private lessons. Maia, a U.S. Figure Skating Gold Medalist, teaches Adult Learn to Skate and Moves in the Field. Brianna, a gold medalist in her seventh season, specializes in power skating and edge development for travel hockey players, as well as figure skating jumps, spins, and off-ice conditioning. Coaches like Amelie and Abigail teach both children and adults, from beginners to competitive athletes, in private, semi-private, and group settings. Skaters booking online should adjust their time to the Eastern Time host time zone for accurate scheduling.

providers.name: World Martial Arts Center (Happy Kicks)
providers.shortDescription: A Korean martial arts school on Washington Avenue teaching hapkido and taekwondo to children, with an afterschool program and school-break day camps.
providers.longDescription: World Martial Arts Center, which trades as Happy Kicks, teaches hapkido and taekwondo at 1120 Washington Avenue, just south of Empire Boulevard in Prospect Lefferts Gardens. The children's side of the school is substantial rather than an add-on: separate class tracks for children and adults, an afterschool program with pickup, day camps in winter and spring and over the summer, leadership training for students who stay with it, and birthday parties. A free trial is offered before enrolling. Parents should know this is a traditional Korean school — belt progression and etiquette are part of it, not just the kicking.

providers.name: Tutu Camp
providers.shortDescription: An unforgettable camp experience where children explore ballet through classes, costume decoration, and storytelling.
providers.longDescription: Tutu Camp offers an enchanting summer experience where kids can explore the magical world of ballet through a variety of activities. From ballet classes and crafting costumes to learning about famous stories like Swan Lake and Sleeping Beauty, children will have the opportunity to create their own productions without any prior ballet experience required. Parents can register their children for camp sessions that focus on different classical ballet tales, ensuring fun-filled days filled with leaping, twirling, and imaginative adventures. Register now or contact us for more information.
